title: PROPOSED MONUMENT: PARK LA BREA
text:
PROPOSED MONUMENT: PARK LA BREA

  CHC-2026-2159-HCM
  CEQA: ENV-2026-2160-CE  Council District: 5 – Yaroslavsky
  Plan Area: Wilshire  Last Day to Act: 10-31-26

  PROPERTY ADDRESS:  6200 West Burnside Avenue; 6002 – 6298 West 3rd Street; 5551 – 6039
  West 6th Street; 406 – 581 South Alandele Avenue; 6100 – 6200 West
  Blackburn Avenue; 321 –533 South Burnside Avenue; 5815 – 6286 West
  Colgate Avenue; 334 – 548 South Curson Avenue; 433 – 532 South Curson
  Avenue East; 351 – 535 South Curson Avenue West; 6103 – 6111 West
  Drexel Avenue; 430 – 530 South Fairfax Avenue; 350 – 533 South Fuller
  Avenue; 300 – 517 South Gardner Street; 400 – 595 South Genesee
  Avenue; 301 – 541 South Hauser Boulevard; 5729 – 6042 West Lindenhurst
  Avenue; 6050 – 6065 West Maryland Drive; 510 South Masselin Avenue;
  5911 – 6059 West Metropolitan Plaza; 405 – 599 South Ogden Drive; 6100
  – 6114 West Ogden Drive; 330 – 588 South Orange Grove Avenue

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Determine that the proposed designation is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 19, Section 15308, Class 8 and Article 19, Section 15331,
  Class 31 of the State CEQA Guidelines;
  2. Determine whether the property conforms with the definition of a Monument pursuant to Los Angeles
  Administrative Code Section 22.171.7; and
  3. Recommend that the City Council consider and declare the subject property a Historic-Cultural
  Monument.

  Owner:  Prime/ Park La Brea Holdings LP Et al.; Prime Park LaBrea Titleholder LLC

  Applicant:  James Dastoli
